segments.comment: A debug Valkyrie level-teleports to D:2 of seed 1002, which has a tended armor shop (see shopkeeper-level-bones), teleports into it, wishes for a beartrap and sets it on her square, which apply.c set_trap() records with add_damage() for the shopkeeper to remove. She waits seven turns on the trap, so its repair delay has passed while repairable_damage() still refuses a trap the hero stands in, then dies to a wished wand of death and saves bones. save.c savedamage() writes the damage record.

segments.comment: A Samurai loads the bones on D:2. restore.c restdamage() reads the record back with its time moved to this game's clock, and bones.c getbones() calls shk.c fix_shop_damage(), whose repair_damage() turns the trap into an object for the shopkeeper. The wizard-mode map (^F), which shows every trap, then shows none in the shop.
